summary: This 6-K filing by TJGC Group Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reports the resignation of two directors, Chan Ka Man and Lai Ho Yin, effective June 30, 2026, with no disagreement stated, and the appointment of two new independent directors, Tian Ke and Lin Junteng, along with a reconstitution of board committees. The changes are routine board adjustments, not prompted by a shareholder activist campaign or strategic review. No financial terms, deal mechanics, or regulatory clocks are involved. This is mapped as a routine current report of management changes, but because the departures and appointments are the sole event and occur abruptly at the board level, this qualifies as a forced/abrupt board departure, warranting a 'Management Changes' special-situation classification.
